title: Milestone 1: Storage and Repository
prompt: Build init_tasks(conn) (create the tasks table from the brief) and TaskRepository(conn) with add(title) -> int, get(task_id) -> dict | None ({id, title, done}), complete(task_id) -> bool, list_open() -> list[dict] (done=0, by id). Duplicate titles raise TaskError('duplicate title'). ALL SQL parameterized.

tests.name: schema + add + get
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
init_tasks(conn)
repo = TaskRepository(conn)
tid = repo.add('ship it')
assert repo.get(tid) == {'id': tid, 'title': 'ship it', 'done': 0}
assert repo.get(999) is None

tests.name: complete flips state once
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
init_tasks(conn)
repo = TaskRepository(conn)
tid = repo.add('x')
assert repo.complete(tid) is True
assert repo.complete(tid) is False
assert repo.get(tid)['done'] == 1
tests.hint: Second complete reports False — no row changed.

tests.name: list_open filters
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
init_tasks(conn)
repo = TaskRepository(conn)
a = repo.add('a'); b = repo.add('b')
repo.complete(a)
assert [t['title'] for t in repo.list_open()] == ['b']
tests.hint: done=0 rows only, ordered by id.

tests.name: duplicate translated to TaskError
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
init_tasks(conn)
repo = TaskRepository(conn)
repo.add('dupe')
try:
    repo.add('dupe')
    failed = False
except TaskError as e:
    failed = 'duplicate title' in str(e)
assert failed
